newsitem.title: UK: REED PLANS TWO-FOR-ONE SHARE SPLIT.
newsitem.headline: REED PLANS TWO-FOR-ONE SHARE SPLIT.

text.p: Reed International Plc, the British arm of Anglo-Dutch publishing group Reed Elsevier , said on Wednesday it planned a two-for-one share split which would take effect in May.

It gave no reason for the change, though companies often opt to split their stock if its value grows to well above the market average. Dividing an expensive stock is sometimes believed to make it more liquid or tradeable.
